title: Effect.
bodyText:
[PART 3.] EFFECT OF ACT 161, SESSION LAWS OF HAWAII 2004

Act 161, Session Laws of Hawaii 2004, shall not affect any action commenced, proceeding brought, or right accrued prior to January 1, 2005.
bodyHtml:
[PART 3.]  EFFECT OF ACT 161, SESSION LAWS OF HAWAII 2004

 

     [§560:8-301]  Effect.  Act 161, Session Laws of Hawaii 2004, shall not affect any action commenced, proceeding brought, or right accrued prior to January 1, 2005. [L 2006, c 29, §1]
